patthana18.18:1.1: āsavañceva sāsavañca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.18:2.1: sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ
patthana18.18:3.1: āsavañceva sāsavaṃ hetuṃ ca sāsavañceva no ca āsavaṃ hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavo ceva na anāsavo ca na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ, hetuyā pañca.
patthana18.18:4.1: āsavañceva sāsavañca na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anāsavo ceva na no āsavo ca na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā pañca.
